song.title: The Great Gig In The Sky

guitar.evidence: David Gilmour's "Black Strat" Fender Stratocaster is one of the most famous and well-documented guitars in rock history.

tone.summary: A highly atmospheric, reverb-drenched signal chain using a clean preamp (US Deluxe) combined with chorus, delay, and heavy reverb to create an ethereal wash of sound supporting the vocal performance.
corrections: track features Clare Torry vocals only
no Gilmour guitar on this song
